subject: ocean quahog clam
title: The Oldest Mollusc Ever Found Was Dead Before Anyone Knew

scenes.text: The oldest mollusc ever found was already dead before anyone knew how old it was.
Ming was dredged up off Iceland in 2006, with about 200 other clams, all frozen on the ship.
Back in the lab, scientists counted a new growth band for every year in its shell.
Their first estimate was around 405 years. In 2013, better methods revised it to 507.
Radiocarbon dating backed up the count.
A clam that quietly lived for over five centuries, and never made a sound.

description:
Ming the ocean quahog clam was dredged up off Iceland in 2006.
Counting growth bands in its shell showed it was about 507 years old, the oldest mollusc ever recorded.
What would you do with 500 years? Tell us below.
